The audiometry results showing decreased hearing sensitivity alongside constant vertigo and nausea are highly suggestive of Meniere's disease, despite the normal MRI. Given your age and the bilateral nature of the hearing loss, have you noticed any recent changes in your blood pressure or used any new medications besides the diphenhydramine? Also, do you have a history of migraines or family history of sudden hearing loss?
